adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the fetch call in refreshOAuthTokens(). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns the response from the sync endpoint directly (lines 6-14 of refreshOAuthTokens.ts). However, the Lark code at line 84 still calls handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, this.log) which expects a Lark-specific response structure with nested data containing refresh_token, refresh_expires_in, expires_in fields. The sync endpoint documentation in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts shows it returns a minimal schema with just access_token and expiry. This mismatch means when credential sync is enabled, the Lark calendar service will fail to properly parse the response.
